recognize_zh: 單顆中性球的核呈 C 字形、未分葉的帶狀，但染色質已明顯粗糙凝集，與核型成熟度不一致（核低分葉），胞質中顆粒偏粗；這種核成熟不同步的表現可作為顆粒球發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）的線索，但單一細胞不足以下診斷。
features: Single mature-sized neutrophil with a C-shaped, non-segmented (band-like) nucleus
Coarsely clumped, mature chromatin disproportionate to the lack of segmentation (nuclear hyposegmentation)
Cytoplasm with relatively coarse purple granules
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; small platelet at lower right
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a C-shaped, non-segmented nucleus containing coarsely clumped, mature-appearing chromatin, a nuclear-maturation mismatch suggestive of hyposegmentation. The cytoplasm contains relatively coarse granules, and hypogranularity is not evident. The surrounding red cells and platelet are unremarkable. In isolation this cell could represent a normal band form; hyposegmented neutrophils with clumped chromatin, when numerous (at least 10% of neutrophils), support dysgranulopoiesis as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms.

ddx.vs: Normal bands have less condensed chromatin consistent with their maturation stage, and their frequency is not increased.
Pelger-Huët affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with bilobed or round nuclei and normal granulation, in an otherwise healthy patient.
Drug-related change is morphologically similar and is separated by medication history and reversibility after withdrawal.
Toxic neutrophils show coarse granules with Döhle bodies and vacuoles but normal nuclear segmentation.
